title: Add per-chat receipt granularity override
description: The spec only has muted/muteUntil on Chat (notification suppression), not receipt sending. Users need per-Chat override of the account-level receiptSharing preference (enable for partner, disable for boss). Affects draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md (Chat object fields). Should be done after or alongside the account-level receipt opt-in issue.
close_reason: Added Chat.receiptSharing optional per-chat override field (chat-00.md:441); updated federation Sender Behavior to use effective preference (Chat.receiptSharing || PresenceStatus.receiptSharing)
